description: ProfileError reason codes that verify_token and verify_proof in prototype/verifier_token.py can raise, plus the three context construction codes. A conforming verifier reports exactly one of these strings for a rejected vector.

codes.meaning: verify_token was called with a context that is not a VerificationContext or a non-integer or negative now.
Catch-all for a malformed direct input that raised a generic ValueError, TypeError, KeyError or similar outside a more specific check.
Envelope is not a byte string or exceeds 65536 bytes.
Envelope or protected header bytes are not deterministic (canonical) CBOR, or carry trailing bytes.
Outer CBOR item is not tag 18 (COSE_Sign1).
COSE_Sign1 body is not a 4-element array, the unprotected map is not empty, or protected, payload or signature is not a byte string.
Protected header map is not exactly {1: -19, 2: ["trace-profile"], 3: media type, 4: 32-byte kid, "trace-profile": profile} for the expected profile, or the signature is not 64 bytes.
Envelope bytes could not be decoded as CBOR at all.
The profile requested for unpacking is not a known profile (not reachable through verify_token or verify_proof, listed for completeness).
Payload JSON contains a duplicate object member name.
Payload bytes are valid JSON but not the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of themselves.
Payload is not JSON, or fails the closed schema (unknown member, wrong type, wrong profile literal, pattern or range violation).
No trusted issuer entry for the (iss, kid) pair, where kid is SHA-256 of the raw issuer public key.
now is outside the trusted issuer [valid_from, valid_until) window.
Ed25519 signature over Sig_structure ["Signature1", protected, h'', payload] does not verify under the issuer key (token) or the cnf holder key (proof).
Protected kid is not SHA-256 of the verifying raw public key (reachable for the holder proof; for the token the trust map is keyed by kid).
cnf.x does not decode to a canonical 32-byte Ed25519 public key.
cnf holder key equals the issuer signing key.
now is not in [iat, exp).
exp <= iat, or exp - iat exceeds the context maximum_lifetime.
exp is later than the trusted issuer valid_until or the manifest_valid_until.
aud differs from the context audience.
sub or instance differs from the context subject or instance.
manifest.digest is not sha256 of the context manifest bytes, or manifest.id differs from the context manifest_id.
verification_context_hash differs from the context question_digest.
appraisal_policy {id, version, digest} differs from the context policy.
The status check could not be completed (context status "unavailable"); fail closed.
The status check returned not active (context status "inactive").
Two components share a component_id.
A component_id is not declared in requirements.components.
Two bindings share (source, target, relationship, method).
A binding tuple is not declared in requirements.bindings.
component_type differs from the matching requirement component_type.
Requirement sets expected_observed_digest and the component observed_digest differs.
A component instance, or a bound pair's instances, differ from the token instance.
appraised_at is after iat, or fresh_until <= appraised_at.
fresh_until exceeds appraised_at + maximum_age_seconds.
An affirming or warning component has no evidence_refs.
An evidence_ref profile differs from its component profile.
Binding digest is not sha256(JCS({method, source: component, target: component})).
A same-evidence-v1 binding whose source and target share no evidence_refs digest.
A component whose authority is the token iss carries an appraisal member; only delegated components carry one.

A component appraisal is not canonical unpadded base64url, or its envelope or payload fails the component-appraisal profile rules (same envelope rules as the token, profile urn:agentrust:trace:component-appraisal:experimental-v1).
A component appraisal signature does not verify under the configured trusted appraiser key found by (component authority, kid).
An authenticated component appraisal whose iss differs from the carried component authority, or whose signed component differs from the carried component minus its appraisal member.
Binding fresh_until exceeds the earlier of its endpoints fresh_until.
exp is later than the minimum fresh_until across required components and bindings.
now >= that minimum fresh_until.
composite_appraisal status, fresh_until, required_components or policy differs from the value rederived by the verifier.
Proof nonce, token_digest, token_id (jti), audience, session_id or action_digest differs from the challenge or presented token.
now outside [challenge_issued_at, challenge_expires_at), proof issued_at or expires_at differs from the challenge, or proof expires_at is after token exp.
Context construction rejected a configured input (bad identifier, digest, policy, requirements, lifetime or issuer mapping). Vectors never expect this.
Trusted issuer construction rejected its own fields (empty issuer, bad interval). Vectors never expect this.
Trusted appraiser construction rejected its own fields (empty authority, empty or invalid profile or component type grant, bad interval). Vectors never expect this.
